action.objective: Commit Kd7, keeping the king connected to the b7 pawn to maximize promotion/drawing chances.
action.rationale: Verified candidates at shared depth 4: Kd7 exact -592 (PV Kd7 Ka6 b8=Q Rxb8) vs b8=Q exact -602. Kd7 passes complete immediate-mate safety and tactical_refutation not_found, and its line keeps the b-pawn for a real promotion try, whereas the promotion line immediately loses the queen to Rxb8. Position is lost either way, so choose the better practical try.
